title: agent_deploy input
description: Have the network serve the agent of a server on the web (an MCP server, an HTTPS API by its OpenAPI document, or an A2A agent): agent.json, the server's address and headers and the agent key are checked, the server is probed and the deploy is recorded as a revision; when its checks pass the revision is announced at the agent's relay address and becomes the active one.

declarations.description: The server's own declarations, as ekl read them.

upstream_url.description: The server's https address on the web: the MCP server's, the OpenAPI document's, or the A2A agent's (or its card's).

upstream_kind.description: What the server at upstream_url is (PROTOCOL.md §5.3).

api_url.description: With openapi: the API's own address, when it differs from the document's first server; kept encrypted.

upstream_headers.description: Headers the network sends to the server, such as its API key; kept encrypted and never shown again.

agent_key.description: The agent's current key; kept encrypted.

callbacks.description: The agent's own callbacks file, for the network to run once it has them switched on.

requirements.description: The packages the callbacks file needs.

callback_url.description: Or the route in the publisher's own app that answers the agent's events.

agent_credential.description: The agent-operation credential the callbacks act with; required with callbacks or callback_url.
